name: DP-NeRF
aliases: DP-NeRF (Rigid Blur Kernel / RBK & SE(3) Fields)
Deblurred Neural Radiance Field with Physical Scene Priors
definition: A method that introduces physical scene priors to handle challenging scenes with blur and exposure, utilizing point cloud 3D priors to synthesize images due to the sparsity of point cloud representation.
summary: DP-NeRF reconstructs clean 3D scenes from blurred images using physical priors and a coarse-to-fine optimization strategy to ensure geometric consistency.
